name: CRISPR Validation Planner
description: Takes upstream CRISPR design decisions (edit type, target locus, and optionally the delivery method) and returns a structured validation checklist recommending sequencing strategies, molecular assays, experimental controls, and an estimated timeline.

inputs.name: edit_type
inputs.description: The category of CRISPR edit to validate. One of: knockout, knock-in, base_edit, prime_edit, CRISPRa, CRISPRi, large_deletion.

inputs.name: locus
inputs.description: Target gene symbol or genomic locus (e.g. 'BRCA1', 'TP53', 'EMX1').

inputs.name: delivery_method
inputs.description: How the CRISPR reagents are delivered. Accepts freeform strings (e.g. 'RNP electroporation', 'lipofection', 'lentiviral transduction') which are normalized internally. Defaults to 'unspecified'.

outputs.description: A validation plan containing: edit_type, locus, delivery_method (normalized), recommended_sequencing (primary strategy), validation_checklist (ordered list of assay steps with category, assay name, purpose, priority, and expected result), controls (recommended experimental controls), estimated_timeline_days, and notes.

validation_checklist.purpose: Rapid screening for heteroduplex DNA indicating successful indel formation
validation_checklist.expected_result: Cleavage bands on agarose gel at expected fragment sizes

validation_checklist.purpose: Confirm the exact indel sequence at the cut site
validation_checklist.expected_result: Mixed chromatogram peaks downstream of cut site (bulk) or clean indel sequence (clonal)

controls.description: Non-targeting gRNA control (same delivery, scrambled/non-targeting guide)

notes: Consider clonal isolation for homozygous knockout confirmation before functional studies.
If antibody for BRCA1 is unavailable, RT-qPCR or functional assays can substitute for Western blot.

validation_checklist.purpose: Confirm the precise base conversion at the target position
validation_checklist.expected_result: Clean single-peak change at the target nucleotide (clonal) or mixed peak (bulk)

controls.description: Catalytically dead base editor control (same gRNA, dead deaminase)
Mock electroporation control (electroporation without RNP cargo) to assess electroporation-induced toxicity

notes: ABE (adenine) and CBE (cytosine) editors have different bystander profiles — check all C's or A's within the ~4-8 nt editing window.
Indel byproducts are rare with base editors but should be monitored via NGS.

validation_checklist.purpose: Measure fold-change in MYC transcript levels upon activation
validation_checklist.expected_result: Significant upregulation (typically >2-fold) of MYC mRNA relative to non-targeting control

controls.description: Non-targeting gRNA with the same dCas9 activator system

notes: CRISPRa does not alter the DNA sequence — genomic sequencing is not necessary for validation.
Multiple gRNAs tiling the promoter region of MYC can be tested to maximize activation.
